title: AI Code Editor Documentation - Zed
snapshot_note: Structured fact packet distilled from Zed's public AI overview documentation.

facts.statement: Zed describes itself as an open-source AI code editor.

Zed says AI runs throughout the editing experience, including agents that read and write code, inline transformations, code completions on every keystroke, and conversations with models in any buffer.
Zed says its AI features run inside a native, GPU-accelerated application built in Rust.
Zed says there is no Electron layer between the user and the model output.
Zed supports hosted models or bring-your-own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, and more than eight other providers.
Zed says users can run Claude Agent, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other CLI-based agents directly in Zed through the Agent Client Protocol.
Zed says AI data sharing is opt-in.
The Threads Sidebar is where users organize agent work and can run multiple threads at once.
